name: One-and-done startup namer (no return loop)
user_idea: A tiny web tool that helps a founder name their startup. They type a few sentences about what their startup does; the tool returns a small list of name candidates with domain availability indicators. They pick one, copy it, leave. There is no account, no saved history, no profile.

phase1.q1_relief_moment: The founder reads the candidate names, sees one that makes them go 'oh, that's the one,' clicks the domain register link, and never thinks about the tool again.
phase1.q2_yesterday: They opened a thesaurus, then a name-generator site full of banner ads, got distracted by the ads, gave up, asked their group chat for ideas, got nothing back.
phase1.q3_one_tiny_thing: Take a description of the startup; return a small list of name candidates with domain availability, ordered by how good they are.
phase1.q4_input_output: Input: a few sentences describing the startup. Output: a list of 5–10 name candidates with .com / .ai / .io availability.
phase1.q5_the_line: No accounts. No saved history. No newsletter. No 'AI naming consultant' chat. No paid plans in v1.

phase2.q2_shape: A tool that does the work
phase2.q2_followup_specific_shape: A page they fill in, then a results page. No conversational back-and-forth.
phase2.q3_first_time: A blank canvas with one button
phase2.q5_hardest_moment: Halfway through their first task — too much work for too little payoff
phase2.q6_failure_scared_of: People love it but won't pay
